sn5.6:1.2: The eldest of three sisters whose verses are recorded respectively: Cālā at [sn5.6]() and [thig7.2](); Upacālā at [sn5.7]() and [thig7.3](); Sīsupacālā at [sn5.8]() and [thig8.1](). There is considerable confusion, as verses ascribed to one sister in SN are attributed to another in the Therīgāthā. The three sisters were taught meditation by Revata ([thag1.42]()).
